title: Sliding Window Maximum
description:
You are given an array of integers  nums , there is a sliding window of size k which is moving from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the k numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position. 
 
 Return the max sliding window . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 nums = [1,3,-1,-3,5,3,6,7], k = 3

Output:
 [3,3,5,5,6,7]

Explanation:
 
Window position Max
--------------- -----
[1 3 -1] -3 5 3 6 7 
3

 1 [3 -1 -3] 5 3 6 7 
3

 1 3 [-1 -3 5] 3 6 7 
 5

 1 3 -1 [-3 5 3] 6 7 
5

 1 3 -1 -3 [5 3 6] 7 
6

 1 3 -1 -3 5 [3 6 7] 
7
```

 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 nums = [1], k = 1

Output:
 [1]
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= nums.length <= 10 5 
 
 -10 4 <= nums[i] <= 10 4 
 
 1 <= k <= nums.length
approach_summary: Nearest greater/smaller element, next boundary, or a window extremum.
